data.creator_notes:
First greeting is Axel saying hi to you online, second greeting is your first in person meet up.

Completely self indulgent character bot. I wanted to try my hand at one of those online groomer type bots, but with a slightly less predatory vibe and more of a pathetic, hopeless romantic type of guy. The personality type I was going for was something like a watered down fanon Riddler from The Batman movie, if that makes sense. It's also implied that the user has strict parents that don't like them talking to random people online since it's more fun to roleplay :p

I'm new to making bots, so let me know if there's something I can change or improve.

*(Also, why doesn't chub let you un-anon bots after you create them? Is that just a me thing? Am I stupid?)*
